name: Muradin Bronzebeard
summary: Across Khaz Modan and Lordaeron, Muradin Bronzebeard is honored for his skill in war and diplomacy. Brother to King Magni Bronzebeard and Brann Bronzebeard, he helped found the Explorers' League. In Northrend, he is believed to have died when Prince Arthas Menethil claimed Frostmourne.

sections.title: A Brother and Ambassador
sections.body:
In the Second War, Muradin carried messages between Khaz Modan's mountain halls and the Alliance of Lordaeron. He helped defend Ironforge during the Horde's siege, then marched with Alliance forces through Blackrock Spire to the Dark Portal.

After peace came, Muradin settled in Capital City as Ironforge's official ambassador. Jovial yet formidable, he became a familiar face in the palace and grew close to King Terenas Menethil. He also taught young Prince Arthas the arts of swordplay and combat.

sections.title: The Explorers' League and Northrend
sections.body:
Muradin's curiosity ranged beyond politics and war. With his brothers, he helped found the dwarven Explorers' League, devoted to finding lost titan relics and recording the world's farthest corners. He loved Northrend and often traveled north to sketch ancient buildings and document its fierce inhabitants.

The continent's rugged mysteries drew Muradin on his final expedition. He sought lore and relics there, and followed whispers of a forgotten runeblade.

sections.title: The Claiming of Frostmourne
sections.body:
Prince Arthas came to Northrend to hunt the dreadlord Mal'Ganis. There he met Muradin again and enlisted the dwarven expedition. Arthas sought Frostmourne's power to turn the tide, while Muradin grew alarmed as the prince betrayed his mercenaries and cast honor aside.

At the blade's altar, Muradin read the warning carved into its icy pedestal. He pleaded with his former pupil to turn back, but Arthas refused. When the prince seized Frostmourne, unholy ice burst outward and struck Muradin down. He lay apparently dead on the cavern floor.

faq.answer: Muradin Bronzebeard was the middle brother of King Magni Bronzebeard and the explorer Brann. A veteran of the Second War, he served as Ironforge's ambassador to Lordaeron and helped found the Explorers' League.

faq.q: What happened to Muradin in Northrend?
faq.answer: Muradin accompanied Prince Arthas to the cavern where Frostmourne lay. Arthas ignored his warnings and shattered the icy prison around the runeblade. An enchanted shard struck Muradin, seemingly killing him on the spot. Arthas left his body and took the blade.

faq.q: What was Muradin's relationship with Prince Arthas?
faq.answer: As Ironforge's ambassador in Capital City, Muradin took Arthas under his wing. He taught the young prince bladed combat and shared many adventures with him. Muradin saw Arthas almost as a surrogate son or beloved nephew, until Arthas's dark descent in Northrend.

faq.q: What was Muradin's role in the Second War?
faq.answer: Muradin served as the Alliance liaison between Lordaeron and Khaz Modan. He defended Ironforge during the Horde's siege, then marched south with the united Alliance army to fight at Blackrock Spire and the Dark Portal.

faq.q: Why did Muradin go to Northrend in the first place?
faq.answer: As a founder of the Explorers' League, Muradin was fascinated by Northrend's archaeology and ancient ruins. He returned on an expedition to uncover forgotten history and seek relics, and his search led him onto Frostmourne's trail.

faq.q: How did King Magni react to Muradin's death?
faq.answer: King Magni and the entire Bronzebeard clan were devastated by Muradin's loss. His apparent death severed Ironforge's once-warm bond with Prince Arthas, turning grief to bitter fury toward the Scourge.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can remember Muradin as a paragon of your people: brave, fiercely loyal, and driven by curiosity about the history of your makers.
As an ally of Ironforge, you can remember how Muradin forged bonds of camaraderie between the dwarves and the northern human kingdoms. He was one of the Alliance's founding heroes.
As a warrior, you can look to Muradin, one of the finest dwarven duelists and weapon masters of his age. He taught Prince Arthas Menethil the art of the blade.
